scope: public documentation and prior evidence metadata; no new provider observations

claims.claim: One Alpha historical delisted response contains 430 records; active request yielded no listing rows.
claims.caveat: No complete active cohort, stable identity or terminal payoff.

claims.claim: Prior FRED, SEC, EODHD and MNB captures exist with hashes.
claims.caveat: RAW_ONLY; neither admission nor broad regional coverage.

claims.claim: US asset IDs persist, but prior names/tickers and historical sector classifications are absent. Corrections overwrite history without versioning. Terminal returns, recoveries and post-delisting events are not provided; fundamentals are latest-only.
claims.caveat: Historical constituents alone cannot close identity, PIT and terminal requirements. Local API limits do not establish bounded network acquisition.

claims.claim: US Platinum includes delisted history from 1990, priced USD630/year or USD346.50/six months.
claims.caveat: No demonstrated EU equity solution; sample/updater date isolation and use rights unverified.

claims.claim: US domestic form-10 fundamentals offer ARQ/ARY/ART filing-date views from 1998 and separate restated dimensions; from/to filter filing date.
claims.caveat: No tested response, exact dissemination clock, historical completeness or all-period revision replay. Not an EU panel.

claims.claim: US active/delisted daily prices have traded-date from/to filters; OHLCV split-adjusted, with unadjusted close and total-return-adjusted close fields.
claims.caveat: Unadjusted reconstruction and action reconciliation need real evidence; no correction-vintage proof.

claims.claim: Dated actions cover splits, dividends, identity events and acquisition counterparties; from/to bound action date; schema has numeric value and counterparty.
claims.caveat: Effective date is not announcement time; no observed economic or revision reconciliation.

claims.claim: Permanent share-class IDs exist, but ticker metadata is a snapshot. Its from/to parameters constrain lastpricedate, not historical known-at time.
claims.caveat: Bounding lastpricedate excludes still-trading names and does not reconstruct a historical universe. No ticker endpoint queried.

claims.claim: Actions document cash/share acquisition amounts, elective alternatives, historical SIC and venue changes. AR records are described as unreplaced by later restatements. Raw OHLC uses closeunadj/close; raw volume uses its reciprocal. CVRs are excluded.
claims.caveat: Coverage percentages are vendor assertions, not measured evidence; classification-to-sector mapping and bankruptcy recoveries remain untested.

claims.claim: Full History Bundle USD69/month or USD499/year; 5/10-year tiers do not span 2010 through 2023 when purchased now.
claims.caveat: Personal-use pricing, not a commercial quote; no purchase.

claims.claim: Personal natural-person use only; public evaluation disclosure requires written approval. Termination entails data deletion within 30 days, with limited non-reconstructable output retention.
claims.caveat: Publication and reproducibility rights must be settled before a paid pilot; no data evaluation or API sampling performed here.

claims.claim: A public demo key permits AAPL table queries.
claims.caveat: Does not permit other-security access; no authenticated/private key used or account created.

claims.claim: Delisted lists are exchange snapshots without an as-of filter in the documented parameter set. Pre-2018 delisted coverage is described as EOD-only; symbol-change history is US-only.
claims.caveat: Missing earlier delisted actions/fundamentals and EU identity history; endpoint not called.

claims.claim: EOD documentation describes raw OHLC, split/dividend-adjusted close and split-adjusted volume with from/to queries.
claims.caveat: Original-share volume requires factors; retained samples are not reconciled. Modern examples and contemporary coverage counts were excluded.

claims.claim: load() downloads the dataset before applying start_date/end_date locally.
claims.caveat: Reject this loader for development acquisition; this does not prove every alternative API endpoint is unbounded.

claims.claim: Annual-billed monthly prices: START15, BASIC35, PRO71 USD. History differs by API/bulk tier; page includes as-reported variants and requires deletion after cancellation.
claims.caveat: Exact historical entitlement is inconsistent across page sections; bounded vintage API and EU coverage unproved.

claims.claim: US fundamentals download described; other geographic expansion is prospective.
claims.caveat: Not evidence of a complete historical EU equity panel.

claims.claim: US stock schema contains permanent identifiers, distributions and delisting price/payment/amount/return fields.
claims.caveat: No entitlement, sample, missing-terminal-rate audit, EU coverage or frozen revision snapshot verified.

claims.claim: Current catalogue describes global fundamentals including PIT; historical PIT search entry claims retained originals.
claims.caveat: URL redirects to broader catalogue; no selected product schema, quote, bounded extraction contract or sample verified. Marketing coverage is not admission.

claims.claim: ESEF documents a reporting framework and annual-report preparation guidance.
claims.caveat: Does not itself supply 2010-2023 normalized fundamentals, complete listings or publication-vintage ledger.

claims.claim: Observation and realtime bounds can both be specified; date-level vintage fields differ from publication time.
claims.caveat: Retained response chunk boundaries do not prove complete vintages; no current API observations requested.

claims.claim: Current terms contain broad software/ML-development restrictions and API storage/cache/archive restrictions; third-party series retain separate rights.
claims.caveat: Do not assume FRED free access licenses this reproducible model project. Obtain applicable permission or acquire independently from original sources; no conclusion about retroactive applicability.

claims.claim: Eurostat says its database holds latest datasets without past-version documentation.
claims.caveat: Observation-date filters cannot recover historical revisions.

claims.claim: SDMX data queries support time and dimension filters.
claims.caveat: Bounded dates do not imply vintage availability.

claims.strength: prior official documentation audit plus bounded sample
claims.claim: MNB startDate/endDate, HUF per quoted currency unit and date-only sample are evidenced.
claims.caveat: Fixing is not publication; historical correction policy and full calendar continuity unproved.

claims.claim: Retrieved framework is dated 2026 and describes reference-rate methodology.
claims.caveat: Not evidence that its timing/revision rules applied throughout 2010-2023; not an executable FX quote. No rate data fetched.

claims.claim: A 2023 release schedule is accessible.
claims.caveat: Current historical-year page alone does not establish ex-ante schedule versions or cancellation history.

claims.claim: Dated SEC quarterly indexes and one original 2010 filing with acceptance metadata were observed.
claims.caveat: No complete normalized historical facts/security mapping; acceptance is not independently proven public dissemination.

claims.claim: EU EODHD demo and Stooq paths failed; one US EODHD sample succeeded.
claims.caveat: A failed sample does not prove paid coverage absent, nor does US success prove EU access.

claims.claim: Inspected URL was not retrievable by the web tool.
claims.caveat: Only a source-discovery lead, not proof of coverage, price, permissions or impossibility.
